Title: Ajay's Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 35 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Sanjay - 67 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ajay stands in the living room. Sanjay stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ajay pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Ajay: "One more time!"

[Ajay drinks a beer.]

Sanjay: "Ajay, are you okay?"

[Ajay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Ajay: "Careful!"

[Ajay walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Ajay: "I really enjoyed today."
